note: E-3 batch demo seed (C-1.3 labeled INPUT). approved=false until the owner approves the billable run (C-7.2). 8 episodes x 3 target languages (es-ES, fr-FR, de-DE) = 24 dub jobs + their deterministic chains. Scripts are short demo lines (the cockpit dubs the line, not the whole episode). source_ref values point at the project GCS bucket objects uploaded at seed time from fixtures/e3_batch/source/.
